models_evaluated: 19 general-purpose and medical-specialized LLMs (text-only and multimodal), individual names not given in the text

links.outcome: LLM next-response quality versus online physician responses on rubric criteria
links.effect: Frontier models remain below the online physician response. Some meet as many or more positive criteria than physicians but trigger more negative criteria.
links.quote: Our results show that image information is critical for reliable clinical performance and that current frontier models remain below the online physician response.

unlisted_practices: Using patient-uploaded medical images (multimodal input) in medical consultation AI to improve performance

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates 19 LLMs on a real-world multimodal benchmark (MedRealMM) for online medical consultation, assessing clinical quality and safety-sensitive error avoidance without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
